limitations: CPU fixture processes inputs serially inside a batch; reduced backend-call count is not evidence of GPU/model speedup.
Observed timings are one local run including net/http, scheduling and SHA-256; no production throughput or tail-latency guarantee.
Tenant labels are caller-provided in this lab; identity authentication and external admission are not implemented.
Cancellation/deadlines require cooperative backend code; a blocked Go function cannot be forcibly killed.
report.transport: actual httptest loopback HTTP for load/cancellation; direct API for controlled fairness
